sentences.text: Md. Shahidullah @ Jadu vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 6

23.
06-03-2026
(ct. no.34)
 debajyoti
 In The High Court At Calcutta
 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction
 Crr 5237 of 2024
 Md. Shahidullah @ Jadu
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Mr. Milon Mukherjee, Sr. Adv.,
 Mr. Md. Ashraf Ali, Adv.
 ... For the Petitioner.
 1.
Heard the submission of the learned Senior Advocate representing the petitioner.
Perused the materials as well as the contents of the written contents whereby the case was started under Sections 69/91 of the BNS.
Charge sheet has been submitted after filing of this revisional application on January 17, 2025 under Sections 376 and 417 of the IPC.
Therefore, prima facie, it appears that an arguable case has been made out since inconsistencies are there in the nature of allegation levelled as well as the charge sheet submitted.

2. The petitioner is directed to serve copies of this revisional application upon the State of West Bengal, service through the office of the learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta, and upon the opposite party no.2 through Speed Post and to file Affidavit-of-Service on the next date of hearing.

3. Let the matter appear before the regular Bench in the Combined Monthly List of April, 2026 under the heading "Contested Application".
4. Let there be stay of all further proceedings pending before the learned court qua the petitioner till April 30, 2026 or until further orders, whichever is earlier 5.
All parties shall act on the server copies of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
